propositions: Exact retirement overlaps remain detectable when tombstone replacement succeeds but live replacement fails, leaving identical identity in both retired and live state.
Recovery must be invoked after under-lock staleness validation but before first remote issue fetch, and only when tombstone, forward entry, and reverse entry identities agree exactly.
Explicit unretire removes the durable tombstone and prevents completion; automatic 200/clear_absent/same-key confirm does not implicitly resurrect a tombstoned identity.
Construction, preview, dry-run, and filtered operations must perform zero writes during retirement-completion; the completion operation is write-bearing only at the validated reconcile boundary.
Rich-text handler must use the narrow facade operation instead of mutating entries obtained from all_bindings().
